name: Mubboo Flights Search
description: Free, no-key airport lookup, trip-input validation and ready-to-open flight-search links into a travel comparison website covering 800+ airlines and 100+ booking sites, with options such as Booking.com, Trip.com, Expedia and Agoda depending on route, dates and market. MCP tools: `find_airports`, `prepare_flight_search`, `get_service_info`; no live fares, availability, booking or payments.
